question: How do existing systems generate music from images, and what should improve Fractal Music?

items.title: Musical Vision: an interactive bio-inspired sonification tool to convert images into music
items.evidence: Configurable color-to-MIDI/instrument/pitch mappings, harmonic polyphony, harmonizer, interactive duration; publisher abstract reports a 12-person pilot and nearly 70% accuracy after less than 25 minutes training.
items.implication: Keep mappings configurable and add a composition/harmonization layer instead of raw pixel tones.

items.title: A Hierarchical Visual Feature-Based Approach For Image Sonification
items.evidence: Abstract describes pixel color edges/texture, region gradients/color distributions, segmentation, and mappings across notes/octaves, timbre, loudness, pitch, rhythm, and distortion.
items.implication: Assign different visual feature levels to different musical channels.

items.title: Photone: Exploring Modal Synergy in Photographic Images and Music
items.evidence: Global image color plus cursor-pixel color drives a dynamic musical score; interaction changes the music.
items.implication: Make zoom/pan/touch meaningful musical exploration controls.

items.title: Sonification of a 3-D Spider Web and Reconstitution for Musical Composition Using Granular Synthesis
items.evidence: Maps spatial data to pitch, amplitude, and envelope, then reconstitutes musical building blocks with granular synthesis into melody, rhythm, harmony, and chords.
items.implication: Separate faithful image sonification from event-level musical recomposition.

items.title: Erie: A Declarative Grammar for Data Sonification
items.evidence: Supports multiple encoding channels, synthesizer designs, auditory legends, sequencing, and overlays.
items.implication: Use an internal event/mapping layer before synthesis; do not add the dependency.

items.title: PONIFY: Pose-Driven Painting Sonification
items.evidence: Maps perceived visual dynamics to tempo and musical density; reports better alignment than methods without pose analysis.
items.implication: Use frame-to-frame fractal change to drive attacks, fills, tempo energy, and density.

items.title: A Systematic Review of Mapping Strategies for the Sonification of Physical Quantities
items.evidence: Review of 179 publications and 495 mappings; pitch was the dominant auditory dimension and mapping evaluation was marginal.
items.implication: Add objective and listening evaluation before increasing pitch complexity further.

items.title: Emotion-Guided Image to Music Generation
items.evidence: Uses valence-arousal conditioning and Transformer MIDI generation; reports polyphony rate, pitch entropy, and groove consistency as metrics.
items.implication: Use these metrics for offline diagnostics; defer ML generation for mobile simplicity.
